svg.title: Recommended Type 2 hierarchy with a clock hub
svg.desc: The hub disciplines the DAC audio clock. The DAC returns a qualified timing reference that disciplines transport audio production. Forward stereo data and return credit control remain separate services, with distinct DAC interfaces for the hub and transport.
